svg.title: What an actor is
svg.desc: An actor has an address, such as lockstep://n1/user/counter#100000003, a mailbox where messages wait, and a behavior with private state. It takes one message at a time from the mailbox. For each message it can do three things: send messages to actors whose addresses it has (lockstep.Send and lockstep.Ask), create new actors (lockstep.Spawn), and decide how it handles the next message, which in lockstep means updating its own fields. Nothing else crosses the actor's boundary. From https://github.com/hmdsefi/lockstep.
